answer: Vickrey auction slots price every fake identity. Each new slot bids once in a sealed auction; the price it pays is the second-highest bid, so a farm bids against itself, pushing clearing prices up with no volume discount, since sealed bids hide its own demand. One forged slot costs the prevailing market price plus a 10-POA stake, and fifty clones survive by nothing: each bid clears alone, so the farm pays fifty market-clearing prices. Detected clusters lose every slot and face a 12-epoch bid ban. Like a knoll where the horizon opens only to honest bids, quartz keeps every shill out.
